[[Officer/Legends|Officer]] '''Emil''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] and [[Non-commissioned officer/Legends|non-com]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He oversaw a warehouse on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent seeking to access the warehouse's store of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and parts.
